purpose: Bounded, isolated state-conditioned early-Yarn sheep-for-goose production mix test from V59 teacher diagnostics.
signal: day<=11 AND YARN_STORE unlocked AND observed WOOL price >= 180; redirect at most one goose per market order to sheep while target sheep count <6 and existing/planned capacity allows it.
route_adaptation: If frozen worker intent picks up a goose while sheep is in shed, pick up one sheep; route a sheep carrier to the nearest vacant pasture. If no pasture is visible, the substitution is allowed only alongside BUY_LAND or planned BUILD_PASTURE and placement waits for a vacant pasture.

fresh_gate.sequential_stop_rule: Run one opponent pair at a time. Stop the remaining pairs if the current pair has zero wins, any candidate error/timeout/incomplete game, or negative mean candidate-minus-opponent margin. This is a diagnostic screen, not validation/readiness evidence.
fresh_gate.ledger_audit: No existing reports/plans contain seeds 95610-95612; they are distinct from teacher seeds 95500-95519 and other listed ranges.
